_note: 旁白台词（讲故事的人，第三人称）。text = 中文，en = 英文。新手引导每一段都是：先安静等几秒 → 第 1 句说 Mochi 怎么了 → 第 2 句给线索 → 第 3 句才说怎么帮。孩子自己做到了，后面的句子就不会播。录音：英文 assets/audio/vo_en_{键}.m4a（或 .mp3），中文 vo_{键}.mp3（或 .m4a）；用哪种语言在 src/config.js → voice.lang（默认英文），网址加 ?lang=zh 临时切中文。没有录音的句子用浏览器语音合成。英文录了音的句子，en 按实际录的说法写（字幕要和录音对得上）。规则：句子短；不用命令句；只夸“帮到了”，不夸“更用力/更多”。

wake_2.text: 看看它，说不定它会醒哦。
wake_2.en: Look at Mochi. Maybe it will wake up.

mirror_1.en: Hmm? Mochi seems to be copying you.

mirror_2.en: What if you tilt your head?

mirror_3.en: Give a little nod. Will Mochi copy you?

mirror_ok.en: Mochi is so good at copying you!

relax_2.text: 小萤火虫只敢靠近安静的小朋友哦。
relax_2.en: Little fireflies only come close to quiet friends.

relax_3.text: 陪 Mochi 安安静静待一会儿吧。
relax_3.en: Let's stay nice and quiet with Mochi for a while.

inhale_1.text: Mochi 想飞到云上去，可它还不会飞……
inhale_1.en: Mochi wants to fly up to the clouds, but it can't fly yet…

inhale_ok.text: 萤火虫来帮忙，Mochi 飞起来啦！
inhale_ok.en: The fireflies are helping. Mochi is flying!

inhale_hold.en: Shh… the dewdrop is about to fall…

inhale_down.en: Mochi is coming in to land…

huff_2.text: 它冻得直发抖，小火苗也快熄了……
huff_2.en: It's shivering, and its little flame is almost out…

huff_3.text: 哈一口热气，帮它暖暖吧！
huff_3.en: How about a warm "haaa" to warm Mochi?

huff_ok.en: Mochi is warm now! Thank you!

cough_1.text: 哎呀，有颗小种子卡在 Mochi 喉咙里了……
cough_1.en: Oh dear, a little seed is stuck in Mochi's throat…

cough_3.text: 咳一下，帮它把种子弄出来？
cough_3.en: Could a little cough help get the seed out?

egg_1.en: The dragon egg is so cold…

egg_3.text: 像刚才那样，哈一口热气给它吧！
egg_3.en: Just like before, how about a warm "haaa" for the egg?

egg_ok.en: The egg is a little warmer!

egg_go.text: 我们一起让它越来越暖吧！
egg_go.en: Let's keep warming it up together!
